_doc: WF v8 WP5 (research/v7/WF-V8-PLAN.md): the numbers scripts/v7/gold.mjs and the doctor's hull row run on. Every section is a default until the owner ratifies it (validation zone: round / review / budget numbers, the bar, the setup gate). gold.mjs --config <file> runs on another copy (a replay).

build.rule: the first round: build the model from the setup's decided facts, the drift rects and the blob table; structure may change

list.rule: the worksheet round: A, B, CONFLICT and X items of the merged worksheet first, then C; structure changes only where an item asks

polish.rule: the last round: A / B / C items only, no structural change (an open X or CONFLICT goes to the owner packet); no critic review follows

critics._seats: owner 2026-10-02: Opus 5.5 + Sonnet is the standard pair; fable is a rare tie-break seat only (gold-critic-fable), run in parallel at the owner's call, never the default brief.

agents._maxTurns: modeller 120, critic opus 55 / sonnet 55 (fable 40, rare tie-break seat), auditor 60: the briefs read .claude/agents/gold-*.md frontmatter maxTurns (critics.maxTurns is the fallback when a frontmatter has none)

bar._rule: agree IoU (the drift rects masked as don't-care) >= agree in every turnaround view and the concept; merge.mjs's STOP line uses it

setupHull._rule: doctor.mjs `hull` row (hull.mjs): a view's viewOnly (its foreground the other views carve away) above warn -> WARN, above block -> BLOCK; the concept's conceptOnlyBlob (concept foreground outside the views' hull, in >= 20 px blobs) likewise. doctor.mjs `aspect` row (hull.mjs --aniso): |aspect| H/W or L/W (the views' object's proportions against the concept's) above warn -> WARN, above block -> BLOCK. turnaround.mjs: the setup targets are the warn numbers + no residual BLOCK (the doctor's +-3 % band); its repair KEEP rule is set-level: KEEP when every target is met, else KEEP only when the set's worst viewOnly drops >= keep.viewOnlyDrop AND conceptOnlyBlob rises <= keep.conceptOnlyBlobRise AND no |aspect| ratio grows by > keep.aspectGrow AND no new residual BLOCK. aspect warn 3 % and the keep numbers: the orchestrator's 2026-09-28 defaults; aspect block 6 % (2 x warn, as viewOnly): this worker's default.

setupStop._rule: the setup stop rule (2026-09-28; the marathon needed two re-audit passes to reach it): after `sets` failed whole-set regenerations (turnaround.mjs attempts that errored or missed a setupHull target) or `view` failed repairs of one view (REVERT / FAILED), turnaround.mjs gen / repair refuse (that view / the sheet) and the setup audit's verdict is READY with explicit target-wins rulings (drift rects, decided facts, audit.json acceptBlocks for apply-audit --accept-blocks audit) instead of REGENERATE (goldlib.mjs setupStopOf).

eyes._doc: The files that judge a model (WF-REVIEW-opus.md C11): gold.mjs brief records their hashes (state.json eyesHash), close / merge refuse when one changed during the round, eyes-check re-renders every subject's reference snapshot. Subject templates: {s} subject id, {class}, {target} / {camera} / {layoutMeasured} / {layout} / {census} = subject.json paths (dropped when absent), {views} = every turnaround view image.
